$comment: The logic operators each Feedback Forms v2 question type admits (a rule with any other is refused, 400 "questions[i].logic[n].when.op must be one of <these, sorted> for a <type> question"). The server's copy is OPS_BY_TYPE in lambda/shared/forms_v2.py (schemas/ is not bundled into Lambdas); test_form_logic_ops_lockstep.py pins the two. The builder reads this file (frontend/src/pages/FeedbackForms/model/logicOps.ts: its validator refuses any other op, and its op choices stay within it) and so does the dev mock (frontend/mock-forms-v2.js). A consent has no value to compare: accepted is `submitted`, not accepted (unticked, which is no answer) is `skipped`. See docs/feedback-forms.md#logic.
